text:
Maya Lin: quick sync — Vectorize.ai connector (Milvus backend) needs final packaging for Cloud Marketplaces (Snowflake + Databricks) and an on-prem certified bundle for Nimble Systems. Goal: marketplace listing live May 18 and first pilot with CloudBase SI week of May 20.
Connor Li: timeline sounds doable. we need cert runbook, an installer that works in restricted networks, and clear compatibility notes for Nimble's A800 and T4 racks.
Samir Rao: on the Milvus side i ran 1k-vec perf tests; attaching summary in a sec. we saw query tail latency spike on long vectors — need to tune hnsw efConstruction/efSearch defaults in connector.
Dana Brooks: packaging question — should the marketplace artifact include sample data + demo notebook or keep demos in a separate github repo linked from the listing?
Maya Lin: prefer small demo in the package (notebook + ~10MB sample) so reviewers can run smoke tests offline. link to full repo in details.
Leo Park: ops note: the on-prem bundle must include an offline license activation step and an accepted-certs.pem for air-gapped installs. Nimble requires a signed manifest.
Samir Rao: sample manifest snippet (to include in bundle):
```json
{"product":"rwinference-vectorize","version":"0.9.0","arch":"x86_64","supported_gpus":["A800","T4"],"signature":"<signed-by-nimble>"}
```
Maya Lin: good. CloudBase SI needs a 90min tech workshop after they run validation. propose Wed May 22 10am PT. who can lead?
Connor Li: I can lead the workshop and demo the Databricks notebook integration.
Dana Brooks: marketing ask: two short blurbs (1) marketplace listing copy, (2) partner co-announcement. also need hero image and a 1-min demo video.
Maya Lin: Dana, can you draft both blurbs by May 6?
Dana Brooks: yes.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace intake requirements: required_fields = [vendor_name, product_name, support_email, deployment_options, license_url, privacy_policy, regions, pricing_matrix]. Portal review window = business days only (5bd).
Leo Park: certification checklist: install smoke test, perf baseline (p99 < 150ms for 1k vectors on A800), security scan report, signed manifest, offline-install test.
Samir Rao: perf baseline command i'll add to perf scripts:
```
python perf/run_queries.py --index hnsw --queries 1000 --concurrency 8 --vector-dim 1536 --host 10.0.0.5
```
Connor Li: Databricks notebook snippet for customers (small example):
```python
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()
# read embeddings from parquet and call connector
df = spark.read.parquet('/dbfs/tmp/embeddings.parquet')
# call connector via jdbc-like api
results = spark._jvm.com.vectorize.Client.query(df.select('vec'), 5)
```
Maya Lin: Ops and legal flags: Nimble asked for indemnity clause variant and we must list data residency options for EU and APAC regions. @marketplace-bot can you confirm marketplace requires explicit residency choices?
marketplace-bot: Affirmative. Field data_residency_options required: [global, eu_only, apac_only, customer_vpc]. See /marketplace/policies/region-residency.md
Dana Brooks: partner marketing — Vectorize.ai wants a joint webinar the week after pilot start. likely late May. recommend we coordinate dates after SI confirms pilot availability.
Leo Park: action items summary:
- Connor: lead SI workshop + Databricks demo + provide helm chart (due May 12)
- Samir: perf scripts + tuning defaults + perf report for A800/T4 (due May 10)
- Dana: marketplace copy + 1-min demo + hero assets (due May 6)
- Maya: legal escalation re indemnity + residency wording (due May 5)
- Leo: create certified-onprem bundle with signed manifest + offline activation guide (due May 11)
Maya Lin: i'll spin up a shared checklist doc and a release calendar. please drop any external contact emails here.
Connor Li: CloudBase PM is emma@cloudbase.com, Vectorize partner contact is rafael@vectorize.ai, Nimble systems eng contact is ops@nimble-sys.com.
Samir Rao: one blocker — Milvus upstream fixed a memory leak in 2.2.3; we should pin to 2.2.4 in bundle. will validate next 24h.
Maya Lin: noted. If pin is required, call it out in marketplace details.
Dana Brooks: quick question on pricing matrix: do we publish list SKUs for hosted vs on-prem subscription? marketplace-bot: pricing_matrix optional for private listings but required for public marketplace.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: submit package by May 11 to allow 5bd review and aim for May 18 publication. :spiral_calendar: 
Maya Lin: thanks team — post updates in this thread and i'll update the checklist. if anyone needs me to triage legal convo i can join. :handshake:
